metadata.title: Clicked like I was lost in a maze and somehow got a kill? Valorant, why?!
metadata.description:
Just casually wandering around and boom, 1 kill out of nowhere.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink life choices.
Valorant’s logic: handing out freebies when you least expect it.
Tap if your aim’s a mystery but kills still happen!
